summary: Strip YNAB's own top-level {"data": {...}} response envelope before wrapping output in this CLI's own results envelope, so read/write commands emit results.<field> instead of results.data.<field> — and unwrap BEFORE --select/--compact filtering runs, not after, on the read-command path.
reason: Every YNAB API response wraps its payload in {"data": {...}}; this print's spec absorption never classified that wrapper, so all 28 generated read commands and 16 generated write commands passed it straight through, doubly nesting output and diverging from the CLI's hand-written novel commands. The write-command fix unwrapped before filtering from the start; the read-command fix initially unwrapped only inside wrapWithProvenance (after filterFields/compactFields already ran on the still-wrapped data), which broke public-shape selectors like `accounts get --select accounts` (Greptile PR #1725 review, confidence 3/5, Issue 1). Fixed by unwrapping immediately after fetch in all 28 read commands, matching the write-command ordering.
validated_outcome: Verified live against the real YNAB API (user, plans get, accounts get, and accounts get --select accounts) post-fix: clean results.user / results.plans / results.accounts shapes, and --select now resolves against the public field names instead of requiring a data. prefix. go build ./..., go vet ./..., go test ./... clean; verify unchanged at 78/79 (same pre-existing unrelated resource-path:export finding).
